name: Payment Investigation Case Rejection
definition: Specifies the rejection of an activity linked to a payment. The rejected activity may be the assignment of an investigation case, the cancellation or  the modification of a payment.

RejectedModification.name: Rejected Modification
RejectedModification.definition: Reason for the rejection of a modification request.

RejectedCancellation.name: Rejected Cancellation
RejectedCancellation.definition: Justification for the rejection of the cancellation.

RejectedCancellationReason.name: Rejected Cancellation Reason
RejectedCancellationReason.definition: Free text justification for rejecting a cancellation.

AssignmentCancellationConfirmation.name: Assignment Cancellation Confirmation
AssignmentCancellationConfirmation.definition: If yes, it means the cancellation of the assignment is confirmed.|If no, it means the cancellation of the assignment is rejected and the investigation process will continue.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Reason for the rejection of a case assignment, in a coded form.

InvestigationRejection.name: Investigation Rejection
InvestigationRejection.definition: Reason for the rejection of a case assignment.

RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.name: Related Investigation Case Resolution
RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.definition: Resolution which consists in rejecting the case.
